events.sql:
WITH
-- 1) Define cohort: female patients age 50-60 with LOS >= 72 hours and with diagnoses of type 2 diabetes AND heart failure
cohort AS (
  SELECT
    a.subject_id,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  JOIN `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
    ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'F'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 50 AND 60
    -- admission length at least 72 hours
    AND DATETIME_DIFF(a.dischtime, a.admittime, HOUR) >= 72
    -- require both type 2 diabetes and heart failure diagnoses for the admission
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
      WHERE d.hadm_id = a.hadm_id
        AND (
             -- ICD-10 type 2 diabetes codes (E11*)
             (d.icd_version = 10 AND LOWER(d.icd_code) LIKE 'e11%')
             -- ICD-9 diabetes codes (250* indicates diabetes mellitus; many 250.x0/250.x2 are type II)
             OR (d.icd_version = 9 AND LOWER(d.icd_code) LIKE '250%')
        )
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
      WHERE d.hadm_id = a.hadm_id
        AND (
             -- ICD-10 heart failure codes (I50*)
             (d.icd_version = 10 AND LOWER(d.icd_code) LIKE 'i50%')
             -- ICD-9 heart failure codes (428*)
             OR (d.icd_version = 9 AND LOWER(d.icd_code) LIKE '428%')
        )
    )
),

-- 2) Union medication/order/admin events from emar, pharmacy, prescriptions with normalized med_time and med_name
glp_events AS (
  -- emar: administration events
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    charttime AS med_time,
    LOWER(TRIM(medication)) AS med_name,
    'emar' AS source
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.emar`
  WHERE medication IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- pharmacy: medication orders/administrations
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    starttime AS med_time,
    LOWER(TRIM(medication)) AS med_name,
    'pharmacy' AS source
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.pharmacy`
  WHERE medication IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- prescriptions: medication orders
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    starttime AS med_time,
    LOWER(TRIM(drug)) AS med_name,
    'prescriptions' AS source
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.prescriptions`
  WHERE drug IS NOT NULL
),

-- 3) Filter to GLP-1 agents and events with non-null med_time
glp_events_filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM glp_events
  WHERE med_time IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      med_name LIKE '%liraglutide%'
      OR med_name LIKE '%semaglutide%'
      OR med_name LIKE '%dulaglutide%'
      OR med_name LIKE '%exenatide%'
      OR med_name LIKE '%albiglutide%'
      OR med_name LIKE '%lixisenatide%'
      OR med_name LIKE '%efpeglenatide%'
      -- add additional substrings if needed
    )
),

-- 4) For each admission in cohort, compute first GLP-1 event time (on/after admittime up to 72h) and whether any GLP-1 by 72h
adm_glp_summary AS (
  SELECT
    c.hadm_id,
    c.subject_id,
    c.admittime,
    MIN(e.med_time) AS first_glp_time_within_72h,
    -- any GLP-1 event at or before admittime + 72h
    CASE WHEN COUNT(e.med_time) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS any_glp_by_72h
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN glp_events_filtered e
    ON e.hadm_id = c.hadm_id
    -- consider only events at or after admittime and up to 72 hours (for cohort-level flags)
    AND e.med_time >= c.admittime
    AND e.med_time <= DATETIME_ADD(c.admittime, INTERVAL 72 HOUR)
  GROUP BY c.hadm_id, c.subject_id, c.admittime
)

-- 5) Final aggregation: counts and percentages
SELECT
  COUNT(1) AS total_admissions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN first_glp_time_within_72h IS NOT NULL
            AND DATETIME_DIFF(first_glp_time_within_72h, admittime, MINUTE) <= 12*60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS initial_12h_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN first_glp_time_within_72h IS NOT NULL
             AND DATETIME_DIFF(first_glp_time_within_72h, admittime, MINUTE) <= 12*60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(1)
  ), 2) AS initial_12h_pct,
  SUM(any_glp_by_72h) AS final_72h_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(any_glp_by_72h), COUNT(1)), 2) AS final_72h_pct,
  ROUND(
    -- net percentage-point change = final_pct - initial_pct
    (100.0 * SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(any_glp_by_72h), COUNT(1)))
    -
    (100.0 * SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN first_glp_time_within_72h IS NOT NULL
               AND DATETIME_DIFF(first_glp_time_within_72h, admittime, MINUTE) <= 12*60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      COUNT(1)
    )),
    2
  ) AS net_percentage_point_change
FROM adm_glp_summary;
